name: Hemoglobe's tick scales with Spirit, Stamina and bonus healing (#1978)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Hemoglobe 524907 DurationIndex 8 (15000 ms) with effects 0 and 1 = aura 23 (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL) at Amplitude 1500 triggering Hemopulse 524906 and Pooled Vitality +2 524905, and effect 2 = aura 24 (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_ENERGIZE) at Amplitude 1500 with MiscValue 1 (POWER_RAGE) and base 49 -> 50 internal, i.e. 5 Rage a tick. Its tooltip states the per-tick heal as $524906m1 + $524906ppl1 + $bh*0.1125 + $SPI*0.45 + $STA*0.35. 524906's own record only carries the flat and per-level terms (base 539 -> 540, RealPointsPerLevel 1.05 from SpellLevel 35); its EffectBonusMultiplier is 0.0 and it had no spell_bonus_data row, so bonus healing contributed nothing, and Spirit and Stamina appear nowhere in the record. Power Word: Fortitude 48161 is used as the Stamina fixture (aura 29 SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT, MiscValue 2, base 114 -> +115 Stamina), so the contract requires the per-tick base value to rise by 0.35 * 115 = 40. QA Test +1000 SP 10030 is the bonus-healing fixture (aura 345 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_SPELL_POWER_FLAT, base 999 -> +1000, which Unit::SpellBaseHealingBonusDone counts), so a probe of 1000 base healing must rise by 0.1125 * 1000 = 112. The Rage energize and the Pooled Vitality stacks are native and are only regression guards here.
